scriptLines: limpiarTextos derive(insurance_provider = case(startsWith(claveSeguro, 'medicaid'), 'Medicaid', startsWith(claveSeguro, 'medicare'), 'Medicare', startsWith(claveSeguro, 'cigna'), 'Cigna', startsWith(claveSeguro, 'united') || claveSeguro == 'uhc', 'UnitedHealth', startsWith(claveSeguro, 'aetna'), 'Aetna', startsWith(claveSeguro, 'blue'), 'BlueCross', claveSeguro == 'selfpay', 'Self-Pay'),

phone = case(length(telDigitos) == 11 && startsWith(telDigitos, '1'), concat(substring(telDigitos, 2, 3), '-', substring(telDigitos, 5, 3), '-', substring(telDigitos, 8, 4)), length(telDigitos) == 10, concat(substring(telDigitos, 1, 3), '-', substring(telDigitos, 4, 3), '-', substring(telDigitos, 7, 4))),

normalizarDatos derive(date_of_birth = case(regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM-dd-yy'), regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{2}, [0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'))) ~> convertirFecha
convertirFecha derive(date_of_birth = iif(year(date_of_birth) < 1900, toDate(toString(null())), iif(date_of_birth > currentDate(), addMonths(date_of_birth, -1200), date_of_birth))) ~> corregirFecha
